push.title: W 3-0 vs GPFC Academy | You: 6.1 (bottom 25% MID)
push.body:
A 6.1, BellyTb1. That's a page, not the book.

DID WELL
+ 1 passes (down from your usual 23). Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ Another W: 3-0 over GPFC Academy.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- No key passes from 1 passes. Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
- 2.0 down on your norm. We go again.

Garden drill: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Every great story has a slow chapter. - Coach Lasso
